definitions.rationale: Expands the named xOrYLoopBody statement macro into the translated loop-body AST; it introduces no mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule xOrYLoopBody
    => If(
         Compare(BinOp("%", Name("n"), Name("divisor")),
                 CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
         Return(Name("y")),
         .Stmts)

definitions.rationale: Expands the named xOrYBody statement macro into the translated function-body AST.
definitions.text:
rule xOrYBody
    => If(Compare(Name("n"), CmpOp("<", Int(2))),
          Return(Name("y")),
          .Stmts)
       For(Name("divisor"), Call(Name("range"), (Int(2), Name("n"))),
           xOrYLoopBody)
       Return(Name("x"))

definitions.rationale: Defines the #xOrY proof-harness term as a call to the closure containing xOrYBody.
definitions.text:
rule #xOrY(N:Int, X:Val, Y:Val)
    => Call(closureVal(("n", "x", "y"), xOrYBody, 0), (N, X, Y))

definitions.rationale: Defines the primeSelect result for the base case N below 2.
definitions.text:
rule primeSelect(N:Int, D:Int, X:Val, Y:Val) => Y
    requires D >=Int 2 andBool N <Int 2

definitions.rationale: Defines the primeSelect result when the divisor scan has reached or passed N.
definitions.text:
rule primeSelect(N:Int, D:Int, X:Val, Y:Val) => X
    requires D >=Int 2 andBool N >=Int 2 andBool D >=Int N

definitions.rationale: Defines the primeSelect result for the case where the current candidate divides N.
definitions.text:
rule primeSelect(N:Int, D:Int, X:Val, Y:Val) => Y
    requires D >=Int 2 andBool N >=Int 2 andBool D <Int N
      andBool pyMod(N, D) ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the recursive primeSelect step for a non-dividing candidate.
definitions.text:
rule primeSelect(N:Int, D:Int, X:Val, Y:Val)
    => primeSelect(N, D +Int 1, X, Y)
    requires D >=Int 2 andBool N >=Int 2 andBool D <Int N
      andBool pyMod(N, D) =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines scanLast when the scan terminates without processing another divisor.
definitions.text:
rule scanLast(N:Int, D:Int, OLD:Int) => OLD
    requires N >=Int 2 andBool D >=Int 2 andBool D >=Int N

definitions.rationale: Defines scanLast when the current divisor is the stopping divisor.
definitions.text:
rule scanLast(N:Int, D:Int, OLD:Int) => D
    requires N >=Int 2 andBool D >=Int 2 andBool D <Int N
      andBool pyMod(N, D) ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the recursive scanLast step and updates the tracked previous divisor.
definitions.text:
rule scanLast(N:Int, D:Int, OLD:Int)
    => scanLast(N, D +Int 1, D)
    requires N >=Int 2 andBool D >=Int 2 andBool D <Int N
      andBool pyMod(N, D) =/=Int 0

proved_derived_lemmas.rationale: Its exact loop-summary transition is first proved as loop_correct against X-OR-Y-VERIFICATION, which does not import X-OR-Y-SUMMARY; only afterward does prove.sh compile X-OR-Y-SUMMARY and reuse this rule.
proved_derived_lemmas.text:
rule
    <k>
      #loop(rangeObj(D:Int, N:Int, 1), Name("divisor"), xOrYLoopBody)
      ~> (Return(Name("x")) .Stmts)
      ~> #endcall
      => #pop
    </k>
    <env> 1 </env>
    <scopes>
      -1 |-> BS:Scope
      0 |-> scope(.Map, parent(-1))
      1 |-> scope(
        "divisor" |-> (OLD:Int => scanLast(N, D, OLD))
        "n" |-> N:Int
        "x" |-> X:Val
        "y" |-> Y:Val,
        parent(0))
    </scopes>
    <scopeLoc> 2 </scopeLoc>
    <heap> .Map </heap>
    <heapLoc> 0 </heapLoc>
    <stack> ListItem(frame(.K, 0, 1)) </stack>
    <ret> noRet => retV(primeSelect(N, D, X:Val, Y:Val)) </ret>
    <exc> NoExc </exc>
    <exit-code> 0 </exit-code>
    requires N >=Int 2
      andBool D >=Int 2
    [priority(40)]
